_note: Bộ đề Speaking Part 2 cho Speaking 4, Khóa C3.

title: Speaking 4 — Trải nghiệm và tin vui
description: 4 cue card Part 2 về giúp đỡ người khác, kế hoạch không như dự kiến, trải nghiệm lần đầu và một tin vui.

questions.question_text: Describe a time when you helped someone.
questions.cue_card_reflection: and explain how you felt about helping this person.

questions.question_text: Describe a time when a plan did not go as expected.
questions.cue_card_reflection: and explain what you did about it.

questions.question_text: Describe a time when you tried something for the first time.
cue_card_bullets: When and where you tried it
questions.cue_card_reflection: and explain how you felt about the experience.

questions.question_text: Describe a time when you received some good news.
cue_card_bullets: When and where you received it
questions.cue_card_reflection: and explain why you were happy about it.
